journeys.name: Book an appointment
journeys.description: A customer can choose a treatment and time and receive a confirmation for a saved booking. The server makes a test booking, confirms it was saved, then deletes it.

journeys.name: See treatments and appointment times
journeys.description: A customer can see the available treatments and appointment times. The server loads the treatments, times, and screen settings the booking screen needs; it creates no booking.

journeys.name: Book with recommendations off
journeys.description: When optional recommendations are turned off, a customer can still make a booking. The server makes a test booking with recommendations off for that check only, confirms it was saved, then deletes it; the live setting is not changed.

flags.name: Optional recommendations
flags.description: Turns the optional treatment suggestions on the booking screen on (true) or off (false) without a deploy.

recoveryHooks.name: Turn off recommendations
recoveryHooks.description: Set recommendationsEnabled to false so bookings stop waiting for the recommendation provider. This gets past a recommendation failure; it does not fix a booking-store failure. Set it back to true to undo.
